gate: B5(i) SF tension force-budget (quasi-static, generation-limit probe)

decomposition.unified_with_cortical_gamma_floor: SAME ½·n·f·ℓ generation budget. Cortex: γ_active=½·n2D·f·ℓ, ~36-80× under the MCF7 active target → needs n2D≈16-47/µm² vs the HeLa-proxy 0.6/µm² (NO MCF7 datum). SF: T=N_cross·f, ~180× under Kumar after the per-minifilament fix → needs N_cross≈360 literature minifilaments across one SF cross-section (NO MCF7 SF-NMII datum). Same f≈56 pN dipole, same density-datum gap (areal for cortex, cross-sectional for SF), same architecture caveat: count is the WRONG lever — cortex tension is overlap-set (Chugh 2017 / Truong Quang 2021), SF tension is sarcomeric-polarity-set (§11 SF-2c: random polarity → −61 pN slackening; Hotulainen-Lappalainen 2006).
decomposition.upper_bound_caveat: All factors evaluated at the UPPER engagement φ≈0.99 AND assume coherent axial summation (cos=1). Both are optimistic: realised engagement ~11% (×9 worse) and a random mixed-polarity bundle does NOT rectify (§11). The budget is the CEILING a perfectly-organised sarcomeric SF could reach, not a prediction of the current random-polarity construction.

note: QUASI-STATIC FORCE BUDGET (no stiff-backbone dynamics, no frozen integrator). The single-SF tension is MOTOR-generation-limited and N_filaments-INDEPENDENT (N sets strain ε=T/μ_SF, not the tension). Raw mesoscale tension 4.97e-12 N vs Kumar 1e-08-3e-08 N → 2014x under band: the SAME generation-limit as the cortical γ-floor. Reaching Kumar needs either the mesoscale force-scale factor (~4028x, Route B native:effective parallel-bundle scaling) or a native/density fix — NOT a backbone-stiffness (N_filaments) change. ASSUMPTIONS: φ zero-load upper estimate; per-minifilament series tension; provisional pending the cross-simulator deep-research + B5-method decision.
